known_limitations.voice_pipeline_v1: retired, native mutex crash root-caused; R1 voice substrate (dedicated :voice process, supervised restart, crash containment) is live
known_limitations.voice_organism_v1: R2: sherpa-onnx Kokoro (English, 11 speakers) + Android system TTS (Arabic/fallback) live inside the :voice habitat, downloaded on first use (~103MB, no network after). STT still in-app legacy; multilingual Kokoro + streaming are R3
known_limitations.human_core_memory_substrate: annotations only — no queryable memory subsystem yet (Memory Interface §16 is a port)
known_limitations.jev_independence: Friday owns a native phone-action decision contract and local allowlist policy; the official Jev model remains a hosted optional provider because TypeSafe has not released its weights.
known_limitations.application_self_study: Friday now reads a generated, read-only source symbol index (file paths, packages, declarations and source revision) alongside the packaged organ graph, capability manifest, wiring and measured runtime outcomes. The index does not contain source code or prove semantic understanding.
known_limitations.self_rebuild: The on-device builder currently creates and validates bounded declarative tools inside an isolated mutant habitat. Friday can inspect a build-generated source symbol index but cannot yet rewrite arbitrary Kotlin/Android source, compile, sign or silently replace the installed application. Native upgrades require a verified signed update.
known_limitations.voice_phone_command_orchestrator: Voice commands currently use a bounded local vocabulary with polite-phrase normalization. Generic taps and text entry require a short-lived explicit spoken confirmation. Broad open-ended app workflows, arbitrary UI understanding and actions blocked by Android permissions are not claimed.
known_limitations.jev_optional_remote_decision_provider: Jev Choice, Score and Noul can evaluate a proposed phone action when the user configures a key and connectivity is available. Friday retains local low-risk handling when Jev is unavailable; consequential or ambiguous interactions still require confirmation. Jev is not a local downloadable model.
